name: dsh-connector-ui
description: Fishball's UI in the main DeepSeek Harness: the one package that changes the host DSH's UI for Fishball (R-ARCH-04).
//: Lowercase name (S4-Q3 decided B). The host half is index.js with src/host/ (U-SHELL, U-DRAW: runtime service lookup, connector-missing and instance-missing, the notify and attention tool declaration, and its own owner-only Fetch routes for availability, status and admission). The browser half is src/client/client.js with its package-local chunks beside it, flat client.<part>.js files because DSH serves only client.<name>.js siblings of a package's client.js: client.shell.js, client.marks.js, client.attention.js (U-DRAW removed client.records.js: no inline records, requirements 1.41 Q-G4; I-HOST moved the instance card, client.instance.js and the status-line symlink client.status.js, to the instance's own settings page).
//dependencies: dsh-connector-shared is the DSH side's library (R-ARCH-08): the request-hostname rule the admit route shares with dsh-instance. It is bundled, so the tarball carries it, as for the connector and the instance.
//peerDependencies: Both optional (design §9.1): the UI's parts follow the instance's and the connector's services and routes when present, and embed-UI imports no code of either. The range is this release's 1.0.0-alpha.1 up to, not including, 2. The connector's npm name is dsh-agent-connector (the user, 2026-11-17).

dsh.//client: What each inject orders before this client: renderer (slots), layout (the main area and `layout`), sidebar (the panel list), workspace (the session row and menu seats), conversation (the header actions), locale, plugin-manager (`pluginNavigation`, for the Retry link). dsh-client-ui-settings is not listed: embed-UI has no settings card and needs no `configForms` (R-UI-06).
